name: strong_move90_shallow_retrace20
description: Prior move over t-90m..t-20m has |return| >= 0.6%; retracement over t-20m..t (now) is OPPOSITE in sign (genuine pullback, not a continued extension) and its magnitude is <= 50% of the prior move's magnitude (shallow giveback, structure preserved).
